description: A radiotap capture utility that outputs pcap dumps, handling wireless network frames, filtering, and ring buffer management.

methods.name: check_type
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is of type ARPHRD_IEEE80211_RADIOTAP.

methods.name: set_promisc
methods.description: Enables or disables promiscuous mode on the network interface.

methods.name: sig_dump
methods.description: Signal handler to trigger dumping ring buffer contents.

methods.name: sig_teardown
methods.description: Signal handler to stop the capture loop and shut down.

methods.name: write_pcap_header
methods.description: Writes the pcap file header to output.

methods.name: write_pcap_frame
methods.description: Writes a captured frame with timestamp to output.

methods.name: ringbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes a ring buffer for storing packets.

methods.name: ringbuf_add
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the ring buffer with current timestamp.

methods.name: ringbuf_get
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the ring buffer at a specified index.

methods.name: ringbuf_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the ring buffer.

methods.name: msg
methods.description: Outputs messages either to syslog or stderr depending on daemon mode.
